failure.cause: A SIGSTOP-frozen established Runner was reported alive and preserved indefinitely, preventing replacement.

repair: Keep bounded preservation for startup and Host reconnect; let an established unresponsive Runner be replaced after the ordinary connection grace using the local liveness stamp. Superseded-process reaping remains required.

negative_control.source: original production code with expanded controls

test_configuration.processes: real local Server, Host, Runner and native harness CLIs
test_configuration.strict_matrix_selected: send only; stop and approval deselected
test_configuration.proxy_isolation: proxy variables removed only from native test child processes; loopback excluded from proxies

invalid_attempts_retained: Initial negative-control setup used an invalid monkeypatch target; not a recovery result.
First SIGSTOP retest failed during localhost mock setup through an inherited proxy; no fault injected.
limitations: Distinct test runs are not a single full twelve-case matrix.
Historical send/stop and managed-approval receipts retain their own source identities.
No Aliyun Host, real model, deployed authorization, STS renewal, capacity, canary, rollback or production release acceptance.
manual_verification: On an authorized isolated test deployment, freeze an already connected Runner with SIGSTOP, send one message and confirm exactly one replacement launch and old Runner reaping before teardown.
Disconnect only the isolated Host for 20 and 150 seconds; restore it and confirm each queued message is processed once in order with a usable next turn.
